title: A Failure-Driven Data Flywheel for Post-Training Vision-Language-Action Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.34698v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Pretrained vision-language-action (VLA) models rarely satisfy all behavioral requirements of a new platform, and teams without a large deployed fleet lack the data to address the resulting failures. We propose a failure-driven data flywheel for post-training such models. It constructs target scenarios absent from the available data by inserting task-relevant entities into reconstructed real-world scenes, and evaluates the model against each behavioral requirement of the target task. Failure rates form a failure map across task conditions and difficulty levels, which is re-evaluated after each round and assigns larger data generation quotas to conditions where the model still fails. We instantiate the framework in autonomous driving for occluded-pedestrian emergence and yielding at stop-sign-controlled intersections, and evaluate it on two VLA models and one non-VLA planner in simulation and on a real vehicle. translated_title: 面向视觉-语言-动作模型后训练的失败驱动数据飞轮
translated_abstract: 预训练的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型很少能完全满足新平台的所有行为要求，而缺乏大规模部署车队的团队也没有足够的数据来解决由此产生的失败问题。我们提出了一种用于后训练此类模型的失败驱动数据飞轮。该框架通过向重建的真实世界场景中插入与任务相关的实体，来构建现有数据中缺失的目标场景，并针对目标任务的每一项行为要求对模型进行评估。失败率构成了一个覆盖各种任务条件和难度级别的失败地图，每轮训练后都会重新评估该地图，并为模型仍然失败的条件分配更大的数据生成配额。我们在自动驾驶领域实例化了该框架，应用于被遮挡行人突然出现以及在停车标志控制的交叉口让行两个场景，并在仿真和真实车辆上对两个VLA模型和一个非VLA规划器进行了评估。对于被遮挡行人突然出现的场景……（原文截断）
tldr: 提出了一种失败驱动的数据飞轮框架，通过在重建场景中生成针对性数据、依据失败地图动态分配数据生成配额，使VLA模型在自动驾驶等新平台上持续改进以满足行为要求。
en_tdlr: Proposes a failure-driven data flywheel that generates targeted scenarios by inserting task-relevant entities into reconstructed real-world scenes and dynamically allocates data generation quotas based on a failure map, enabling continuous post-training of VLA models to meet behavioral requirements on new platforms such as autonomous driving.
